description: CM Naidu instructed officials to prioritise AI-based healthcare services, digital health records and proactive disease management under the project
body_lead: Andhra to roll out AI-powered ‘Sanjeevani’ healthcare initiative from Jan 1, 2027 CM Naidu instructed officials to prioritise AI-based healthcare services, digital health records and proactive disease management under the project By Newsmeter Network Amaravati: Chief Minister Nara Chandrababu Naidu has directed officials to implement the AI-powered healthcare initiative ‘Sanjeevani’ across Andhra Pradesh from January 1, 2027. He emphasised the need to leverage technology for early disease detection, treatment and follow-up care.
